ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x} (k\ne 0)$ passes through the points $(-2, 4)$ and point $A(a, -2)$. If the point $C(x, y)$ is also on the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x} (k\ne 0)$, when $2<x<8$, find the range of values for the function $y$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that point $C(x, y)$ is also on the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=-\frac{8}{x}$, \\
$\therefore$ when $2<x<8$, $y$ increases as $x$ increases, \\
when $x=2$, we have $y=-4,$ \\
when $x=8$, we have $y=-1,$ \\
$\therefore -4<y<-1.$ \\
Therefore, the range of function $y$ is $\boxed{-4<y<-1}$.
